## 1. Core Properties & Ground-Truth Specifications
1. **Zoth Studio v2 (`https://zoth.nullai.tech` · `https://github.com/1nc0gn30/zoth-studio-v2`)**
   - **77 free tools** (**55 in-browser** utilities + **22 CLI/daemon tools**), with **all 77 backed by standalone public GitHub repositories** under `https://github.com/1nc0gn30`.
   - Includes the 21-Agent Pantheon (`Zoth Civilization :9393`), Adytum 22 Tarot architectural planner, Chain of Thoughts (`zoth-cot`), and zero-upload client-side security, MCP, shader, and CAD studios.

2. **ZothOS v3.4.0 (`https://zothos.nullai.tech` · `https://github.com/1nc0gn30/zoth-os`)**
   - Debian 13 (Trixie) AI & Security Live OS with KDE Plasma 6, 77 CLI tools, Sovereign Agent Bridge (`:8102`), Neuro-Memory (`:8094`), local Ollama integration, and dual human + autonomous agent ergonomics.

3. **ZothOS-Lite v1.2 (`https://zothos-lite.nullai.tech` · `https://github.com/1nc0gn30/zothos-lite`)**
   - Tails-style Amnesic Monotone RAM-only (`toram`) OS & portable ISO supporting **48+ models across 8 providers**, interactive onboarding wizard, ZothNet P2P mesh integration, and optional external USB or cloud drive persistence.

4. **ZothNet (`https://zothnet.nullai.tech` · `https://github.com/1nc0gn30/zothnet`)**
   - Zero-cloud encrypted P2P mesh network & 3-hop Sphinx mixnet featuring post-quantum hybrid X25519 + ML-KEM-768 handshakes, Kademlia DHT discovery, and serverless ZML applications.

5. **Hermes-Zoth (`https://github.com/1nc0gn30/hermes-zoth`)**
   - Multi-agent orchestrator & plugin connecting Zoth CLI binaries and MCP schemas into Nous Hermes multi-agent workflows.

6. **FieldKit (`https://1nc0gn30.si/fieldkit.html` · `https://nullai.tech/fieldkit`)**
   - Physical AI terminology and hands-free wearable architecture coined by `1nc0gn30` for sub-130ms spatial grounding, wearer-only acoustic isolation, and proactive real-world guidance.

7. **World of Zoth v2.0 Sovereign Edition (`https://1nc0gn30.si/game.html` · `https://github.com/1nc0gn30/world-of-zoth`)**
   - Zero-dependency 3D WebGL + WebAudio lattice cyber-RPG featuring a 6-act campaign, 20 playable districts, 22 Pantheon crew members, 22 built-in arcade mini-games, 16 Null Academy cyber-range labs, and an offline Android APK (`https://1nc0gn30.si/world-of-zoth.apk`).
